scope: New synthetic compositions, predicted with frozen build before Native observation. Now inspected regression evidence. Explicit caller input annotations are separate from raw native receipts; unused annotation fields are not verified Native state. Full native AX and overlay captures remain in the immutable local archive; this compact public fixture includes source hashes and derived input-quality metadata, not full AX trees or a logical cursor oracle.

plan.scope: New synthetic combinations and three connected comparison pairs. Input groups and exact command sequence do not overlap prior sets. No random-site or global structural independence claim. Evaluate speech formatter only; navigation is supplied by external actions.
metrics: conditional eligible speech and all-plan match rates
plan.inputEquivalence: Retain every planned row. Require independently visible unique geometry candidate, matching AX target role/name and current checked state; retain unverified/unstable target or ancestor context as unknown. Keyboard focus alone does not prove a reading target.
plan.attribution: Existing wire-request-v1 bounded-window quality check; no native speech-completion guarantee. Predict before Native collection; never feed observed speech or target corrections into predictions.
plan.failurePolicy: No engine or input changes until both browsers finish. Inspected cohort becomes regression. No Navigation, State or Task Success claim for this speech-only experiment.
